name: Visual network
membershipSource: Computed primary membership: highest vertex-overlap (>=25% of network-labeled vertices) between the Desikan-Killiany aparc parcellation and the Yeo 2011 7-network parcellation, both on the fsaverage surface (fsaverage5 annot nearest-neighbor upsampled on the registered sphere). Source: Yeo et al., J Neurophysiol 106:1125-1165 (2011), via the CBIG repository. Full overlap fractions: pipeline/networks/report.json. Cortical regions only.
